text:
maria: quick smoke test FYI — preview build for /runtime/guide shows TOC lint error and missing anchor for `batching.md` :confused:

maria: saw it on staging at https://staging.docs.redwood.inference/runtime/guide — small snapshot attached (screenshot uploaded)

tj: can you paste the failing lint output?

maria: yup, copied from CI: `ERROR: toc: unresolved reference 'batching.md#auto-batching' at line 42`

maria: also noticed frontmatter for batching.md has `sidebar: null` which might be hiding it from the generated TOC

tj: hmm, possibly a missing anchor in the doc itself — did the markdown header get renamed recently?

maria: looks like header was `## Auto batching` -> changed to `## Automatic batching` in last PR 2134

docs-bot: deploy-preview/1227 finished — status: failed (lint) — see https://ci.internal.redwood/1227/logs for details

kevin: I can take this one, will search for the header/anchor mismatch and either add a redirect anchor or adjust TOC generator mapping

alyssa: fyi if it's frontmatter we should keep consistent with handbook styleguide — prefer adding an explicit anchor `<!-- auto-batching -->` under the heading rather than relying on redirects

kevin: sounds good, i'll open a small PR with two options: add anchor + update TOC mapping if needed. pinging @maria for the screenshot/context

maria: thanks! here's the minimal repro command I used locally: `hugo server -D --config docs/config.toml` then open /runtime/guide and click TOC

kevin: nice. I'll try that. ETA ~30m. assigning to me in the issue tracker: https://issues.redwood/KB-987

tj: thx kevin. once you have PR link drop it here and i'll do a quick CR — should be tiny

kevin: opened PR https://git.internal.redwood/docs/pull/485 — changes: add `<!-- auto-batching -->` + update batching.md frontmatter to include `sidebar: runtime`

alyssa: quick note: double-check that adding the HTML comment won't break our markdown lint rules (some linters flag html comments)

kevin: good call — ran `npm run lint-md` locally and it's fine, no html-warning in current config

maria: LGTM from my side, screenshot now shows TOC entry present. thanks :sparkles:

tj: done reviewing — left one tiny nit about spacing, but not blocking. :thumbsup:

kevin: addressed nit and force-pushed. CI rerun queued by docs-bot

docs-bot: CI for PR 485 passed — checks: lint, build-preview, linkcheck

kevin: merging now, will follow up if any downstream issues appear

maria: awesome, thanks team. would be great to add a quick note to the doc curation checklist to watch for header renames in TOC-sensitive pages

alyssa: I'll add a one-liner to the checklist doc after lunch — small PR incoming

kevin: thanks all — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
